author: Ukiren
quote:
I played the orignial one on gamecube and the Wii version A LOT, so I was worried about how this was going to turn out, but I think it could not be a better adaptation. 
Pros: -I didn't particularly hate Ashley in the original but this one is definitively better, I even became a fan of the actress.
-Even when some of the parts of the original were modified, I liked the changes, it felt consistent.
Cons: -I felt like the guns were messier in the handling, but that is just my perception. Still good

author: Ukiren
quote: I really liked all the battles against Lace, I really liked the ending. The difficulty was just right, and the platforming was challenging enough for me. The lowered score is because I felt like the music was lacking somewhere.

author: Ukiren
quote: I had to rent a PS5 to try it before scoring. 1 point for the graphics, and 1 point for the scale of the game. Had 3 bugs in the first 3 hours. Sadly, all the situation around this game makes it hard to enjoy. I couldn't believe this game was getting into the GA when it wasn't released, that's the reason several games couldn't make it to the awards, a lot of good ones. I couldn't believe the critics clearly stated the flaws of the game and still put a 100 at the end, that was a first, I felt like a clown after reading the content of the reviews. I'm not used to being lied to my face like this, other companies try to hide it. I simply could not enjoy a game being surrounded by that background. I expected really good things from a game that had that big 99 on the score, but the difference against the actual game was a deception. This could be a 70, even 80, but again, all of this situation worseden my reaction once I tried it.

author: Ukiren
quote: I wasn't able to play the original or the 3ds version, so this is my first approach to this game. It has been a long time since the last time I felt something this strong while playing, I mean, I had a very good time with several games this year, but this one, this one made me feel strong, beautiful emotions. I felt at home.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
